_comment: Scheme documents by AMFI scheme code: { "SIF-3": [ { "kind": "SID|KIM|SAI|ISID|factsheet|portfolio|addendum", "title": "...", "url": "https://...", "date": "2026-08-31", "publisher": "...", "verified": true } ] }. Each entry is itself the source, so this file has no `sources` dict. Only verified entries with an https URL are shown. `amcs` is reserved for house-level documents, keyed by amcId.
